derivation: conftest loads the compose api environment, so the host seen by settings.CACHE_HOST is the typo 'cahce'; Client.__init__ raises 'cannot reach host cahce'. The cause is the VALUE of key CACHE_HOST in compose.yaml. Values are not in the graph (no value flow in the MVP), so the expected answer is the key and its compose file.
title: compose sets the cache host to a typo (value error)
